description: This Java class 'OrderEditor' provides serialization and deserialization of 'Order' objects, enabling integration with Spring framework for passing 'Order' instances through web forms or other mediums. It includes methods to retrieve 'Order' objects by their ID or UUID, utilizing the OpenMRS API's OrderService.

classes.name: OrderEditor
classes.description: A property editor class facilitating the conversion between String representations (ID or UUID) and Order objects for use within Spring and web forms.

methods.name: getObjectById
methods.description: Retrieves an Order object by its numeric ID using the OrderService.

methods.name: getObjectByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves an Order object by its UUID using the OrderService.
